decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) are a flagship tied to the growing glass-core packaging and high-frequency markets, sit close to the firm's existing processing know-how, and are cheap to keep on offer while customer adoption is still uncertain, so the option is worth holding open.

VLIS laser structuring for through-glass vias launched only in 2024 with its own page, so its uncertainty has barely begun to resolve, and it complements Product A in the firm's strategic push into advanced semiconductor packaging, making abandonment premature.
